_meta.description: What a campaign event needs to take its registrations from the landing page and look after them: an online join link, the lead each registration came with, when its confirmation and reminder went out, when it was cancelled, and whether the person came. Named 99-zz so it merges after 98-campaign-events, which declares both schemas. Additive: no existing property changes.

online.title: Online
online.description: The event takes place online; the reminder carries the join link.

joinUrl.title: Join link
joinUrl.description: The link attendees use to join an online event.

lead.title: Lead
lead.description: The lead the sign-up created in the campaign.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.description: Whether the person came to the event.

confirmationSentAt.title: Confirmation sent
confirmationSentAt.description: When the confirmation or waiting list mail went out.

reminderSentAt.title: Reminder sent
reminderSentAt.description: When the reminder the day before went out to this person.
